blocks.text: How many piano tuners work in Chicago? Nobody knows the answer offhand, but a chain of rough guesses gets surprisingly close:

items: About 3 million people live in Chicago, roughly 2 per household: **1.5 million households**.
Perhaps 1 household in 20 owns a piano: **about 75,000 pianos**.
Each piano is tuned about once a year: **75,000 tunings a year**.
A tuner can do about 4 a day, 250 days a year: **1,000 tunings per tuner**.
So Chicago needs roughly **75 piano tuners**.

blocks.text: Each guess may be off, but the errors tend to cancel out, and the answer is very likely in the right order of magnitude. That is the real lesson: an honest estimate beats no estimate.
